doc: The pole fallback: when |z x c| < 1e-9 the east vector is the fixed (0, 1, 0) and north = c x east (north pole: (-1, 0, 0); south pole: (+1, 0, 0)). Rows: exact poles, 1e-10, 3e-10 and 7.1e-10 from the axis (fallback taken), 3e-9, 2e-9, 1e-6 (normal branch, within a factor 3 of the threshold) and the equator. The exact threshold (|z x c| == 1e-9) is not a case: it depends on how the norm is rounded. The threshold itself is pinned to 1e-4 (relative) by tangent_frame.threshold_bracket. float64, rtol 1e-9.
